title: NSS Feed Output Format: Posture Management Logs

blocks.text: Access to Posture Management logs requires Advanced SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM). To get Advanced SSPM, contact your Zscaler Account team.

The Posture Management Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS) feed specifies the data from the Posture Management logs that the NSS sends to your security information and event management system, or SIEM. You can configure an NSS feed by including one or more fields. The fields and their values display in the NSS feed output.

blocks.item: View a sample Posture Management log.
"controltitle": "Ensure NSG rules don't allow unrestricted access",

blocks.text: The following table displays information about the Posture Management log fields and possible values for those fields.

table: The time that the alert was sent
The name of the application associated with the posture control
The name of the onboarded tenant
The labels that you created and associated with the tenant
The title of the posture control
Ensure That Users Can’t Connect from Jailbroken iOS
The unique ID of the posture control
The category of the posture control
The severity of the posture control
The compliance frameworks applicable to the posture control
The status of the posture control
Indicates if any remediation action was done
